text: 🍿 Robert Eggers goes full wolf. It earns the hype. 📆 Release: December 25, 2026 🎭 Genre: #Horror ✈️ Add to watchlist Robert Eggers and the werewolf myth feel like a natural fit, and the trailer proves it. Aaron Taylor-Johnson brings raw physicality, and Willem Dafoe lurking at the edge seals it. Same Focus Features pairing as Nosferatu , co-written with Sjón. SlashFilm calls it the perfect companion piece. I buy that.

🎬 The Dave Bautista horror movie Netflix can't stop watching M. Night Shyamalan's Knock at the Cabin is dominating Netflix charts three years after its release. A family on vacation, four armed strangers, one apocalyptic ultimatum. Shyamalan keeps it lean and suffocating for all 100 minutes. Bautista plays Leonard, the soft-spoken ringleader. It's the best dramatic performance of his career, full stop. He makes you feel sorry for the man holding a weapon to your head. ✈️ Add to watchlist

🎬 Dark Matter season 2 finds the book's darkest beat, and plays it smarter Episode 5 is where the show earns its second season. Rather than a straight lift of what Blake Crouch wrote, the adaptation re-contextualizes the source novel's most gut-punch moment for a story that has evolved well beyond its starting point. That's the move good showrunners make. Joel Edgerton and Jennifer Connelly get material that honors the emotional weight of the book without turning it into a museum piece. Subtle is harder than faithful, and here it actually lands. ✈️ Add to watchlist
